subject: Tomorrow is Easter – Celebrate with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we celebrate Easter, the resurrection of Christ - a profound symbol of the soul's triumph over death and the promise of spiritual rebirth.

Master emphasized that Easter is not only a historical event, but an inner experience accessible to all sincere seekers. The resurrection signals the awakening of Christ consciousness within, leading us toward the realization of our divine nature.

This Easter, let's contemplate the inner meaning of resurrection and explore how this transformation can unfold in our own lives.

Consider these questions as you reflect and converse with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this Easter draw you deeper into the living experience of Christ consciousness.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
